winning_patterns: Short 13-15 second clips with high-energy streamer reactions outperform 30-second clips, with median views of 531.5 vs 271.0
Hooks using all-caps promises or broken physics claims drive the highest YouTube dominance, as seen in GTA-001 with 9900 YT views
Specific streamer names combined with immediate chaos events (crashing, physics breaks) generate cross-platform spikes over generic gameplay
avoid_patterns: Reject 30-second clips with zero engagement like GTA-020 and GTA-012 which received 0-1 views

Do not post clips where the streamer is not visibly reacting or the hook does not mention a specific failure or promise
hook_style_guidance: Write Frame-1 hooks in all-caps that name the streamer and a specific broken promise or physics glitch within the first 3 seconds.
